title: Three Terms and One Short Bell
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：manner　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 manner 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the teacher ① kept the manner that no pupil in the schoolroom would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the term. The ② manner, meaning the way itself and not the bell, ran three terms and stayed unrecorded in the book; a manner, he said, is the only thing in a schoolroom that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ manner in that schoolroom had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ manner at the far aisle, meaning the habit they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A manner, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the teacher said the recording is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the manner was the whole of the matter, meaning the custom and not the way. The ⑥ manner, meaning the custom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; manner, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a way and a custom. He said the custom is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ manner had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ manner of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one schoolroom and three terms of recording; manner, he said, is either the habit at the far aisle or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ manner I remember is the way recorded in the notebook, which closed in 1969 and is still recorded as the quietest in the schoolroom. A ⑩ manner, my mother said in 1971, is the only way that improves by being recorded; every manner, she said, is a custom that has agreed to look like a way. She said the custom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 方式；举止（指学堂里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 方式；举止（指那种方式本身，与铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the manner 保持这种举止
D. n. 方式；举止（指留给孩子们学的那一种那一种）
E. n. 行止之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的举止之事）
F. n. 方式；举止（指笔记簿里写到、被记下的的那一种）
G. n. 规矩、礼貌（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 礼貌（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the manner that no pupil in the schoolroom would have recorded
The manner, meaning the way itself and not the bell
the manner at the far aisle

answers.why: keep the manner 意为“保持这种举止”，1962 年那位先生把学堂里没有一位学童肯记下的一种举止做了一遍。
manner 意为“方式；举止”，指那种方式本身而不是铃，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
manner 意为“方式；举止”，指学堂里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只小小的铃。
manner 意为“方式；举止”，指最远那条过道留给孩子们学的那一种那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
manner 意为“规矩、礼貌”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条规矩就是那件事的全部。
manner 意为“礼貌”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种方式，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
manner 意为“方式；举止”，指笔记簿里写到、被记下的的那一种，到 1967 年这一种成了笔记簿里的一行。
manner 意为“行止之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的举止之事是一处学堂和三个学期的记下。
manner 意为“方式；举止”，我记得的是笔记簿里记下过的那一种，1969 年养成了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一种。
manner 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，举止是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的方式。
